description:
Cast Perch Protection by paying {4}{W}{W} and choosing to gift an extra turn, causing your life total to be unable to change until your next turn.
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing no life due to Perch Protection
Repeat the process in step 3 as many times as desired.
